channel.title: HordeLedger blog
channel.description: Market notes from the WoW Forever Horde auction house.

item.title: Smelting Pays More the Higher the Skill Gate
item.description: Thorium Bar clears about 7s over Thorium Ore after the auction cut; copper and tin clear nothing. Smelting margins on the Horde AH, by skill level.

item.title: Five Cheap Staples Repriced Overnight
item.description: Small Venom Sac, Fish Bowl, Elemental Water and two more jumped 3x to 1,900x in one night on the Horde AH. Which moves are holding and which aren't.

item.title: Silk, Heavy Leather and Iron Bar Hit the Vendor Floor
item.description: Iron Bar, Silk Cloth and Heavy Leather are down about 90% since launch and now trade within 20-30% of vendor price: little downside left for crafters.

item.title: The first 72 hours of the Horde auction house
item.description: We watched one WoW Forever auction house from launch night on. Prices halved, ammo ran a third of all volume, and most listings that vanish come straight back cheaper. Ten things that stood out.
